why: `.env.example` documents what a person has to FILL IN, and nobody fills in `NO_COLOR` in an example file: what defines it is the terminal, and what defines `CI` is the runner. Measured on 2026-08-30, two of the six accused were only this — `alicerce` became "reads 1 environment variable(s) and has no .env.example" with `NO_COLOR` as the repository's only variable, and `prumo` was charged for `NO_COLOR` while having a `.env.example` with `PRUMO_KEK` and `DATABASE_URL` documented. The `pass` side reads ONLY environment variables and has to come out N/A; the `fail` side reads the same ones PLUS a project variable and keeps failing, so that the sieve does not become an escape hatch for the whole rule.
